_comment: Shared corpus of the postgres registry and election providers: the DDL, every statement text ({schema} stands for the connection's schema), the schema command output, the SQLSTATE classes retried as transient and the messages. Pinned so every implementation emits the same bytes.
ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {schema}.fleet_workers (
    worker        text        PRIMARY KEY,
    instance      text        NOT NULL,
    cluster       text        NOT NULL,
    card          text        NOT NULL,
    heartbeat_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS fleet_workers_cluster_idx ON {schema}.fleet_workers (cluster)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS fleet_workers_heartbeat_idx ON {schema}.fleet_workers (heartbeat_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {schema}.archive_locks (
    cluster       text        PRIMARY KEY,
    token         text        NOT NULL,
    worker        text        NOT NULL,
    instance      text        NOT NULL,
    acquired_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    refreshed_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)

publish.sql: INSERT INTO {schema}.fleet_workers (worker, instance, cluster, card, heartbeat_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now()) ON CONFLICT (worker) DO UPDATE SET instance = EXCLUDED.instance, cluster = EXCLUDED.cluster, card = EXCLUDED.card, heartbeat_at = now()

list_prune.sql: DELETE FROM {schema}.fleet_workers WHERE heartbeat_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $1)

list_select.sql: SELECT card, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - heartbeat_at)::float8 FROM {schema}.fleet_workers ORDER BY worker

withdraw.sql: DELETE FROM {schema}.fleet_workers WHERE worker = $1 AND instance = $2

acquire_select.sql: SELECT token, worker, instance, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - refreshed_at)::float8 FROM {schema}.archive_locks WHERE cluster = $1 FOR UPDATE

acquire.sql: INSERT INTO {schema}.archive_locks AS held (cluster, token, worker, instance, acquired_at, refreshed_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (cluster) DO UPDATE SET token = EXCLUDED.token, worker = EXCLUDED.worker, instance = EXCLUDED.instance, acquired_at = CASE WHEN held.token = EXCLUDED.token THEN held.acquired_at ELSE now() END, refreshed_at = now() WHERE held.token = EXCLUDED.token OR held.refreshed_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $5) RETURNING token

refresh.sql: UPDATE {schema}.archive_locks SET refreshed_at = now() WHERE cluster = $1 AND token = $2

is_held.sql: SELECT 1 FROM {schema}.archive_locks WHERE cluster = $1 AND token = $2

release.sql: DELETE FROM {schema}.archive_locks WHERE cluster = $1 AND token = $2

messages.missing_table: table {schema}.{table} does not exist and connections.postgres.{connection}.manage_schema is false; create it with: drakkar-schema postgres --schema={schema}
